title: +750 in 60 Seconds! EASY BONEMEAL FARM Minecraft 1.21/26.3+!
description: In this Tutorial, I Will Show you how to build this new bonemeal farm for Minecraft! This bonemeal farm works on all multiplayer servers; it can be stacked, and it is lag-efficient because of how it is powered, which only uses a boat clock instead of so many observers and tons of repeaters, resulting in a perfect farm that has no lag spikes while working, making this farm a great choice. It is simple and so easy to build, and you can build it in just 10 minutes in Minecraft!
